title: LowKey Anti ItemFrame
description: LowKey AntiItemFrame client-side Fabric mod that prevents accidental right-click interactions with item frames and decorated pots.
body:
**LowKey AntiItemFrame** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that eliminates the frustration of accidentally interacting with item frames and decorated pots while playing.

Ever walked past a decorated display and accidentally shoved an item into a frame, or emptied a decorated pot without meaning to? This mod prevents exactly that. With a single keybind you get instant access to a clean settings GUI where you can control what gets blocked and what doesn't — no config files, no restarts needed.

# Features:

Item Frame protection — completely blocks right-click interaction with item frames, preventing items from being inserted, removed, or rotated
Decorated Pot protection — blocks right-click interaction with decorated pots, preventing items from being inserted into them
In-game GUI — press V (default) to open the settings screen and toggle each option independently
Keybind rebinding — the GUI keybind can be changed at any time in the standard Minecraft Controls menu under the LowKey AntiItemFrame category
Zero performance impact — purely client-side, no server required, no background processing
Both toggles can be switched on and off at any time during gameplay, making it easy to temporarily allow interactions when you actually need them.
